characters.name: Askeladden
characters.prompt: A resourceful and upbeat young Norwegian man dressed in rustic 17th-century peasant clothes, wearing simple leather shoes and carrying a large wooden trough. His hair is slightly messy and he has a determined sparkle in his eye. The setting is rural Norway in the olden days (1400-1850), with wooden farm buildings and a distant fjord landscape.

characters.name: The Oldest Brother
characters.prompt: A tall, somewhat haughty peasant youth wearing slightly finer, but still modest, Norwegian farm attire of the 17th century. He seems dismissive, with crossed arms and a skeptical expression. He stands near stables or a yard typical of old Norwegian farm life.

characters.name: The Middle Brother
characters.prompt: A lanky, slightly anxious young man dressed similarly to his older brother in Norwegian peasant attire from 1600s or 1700s. He appears resentful, standing with his hands on his hips and casting side glances at Askeladden.

characters.name: The Troll
characters.prompt: A large, hulking creature with earthy-toned skin, tangled dark hair, and rugged clothing made from furs and hides. He looms by the entrance of a rocky cave near a Norwegian forested hill. His features are exaggerated, but clearly drawn from Norwegian folklore inspirations of the 15th-18th century.

characters.name: The Troll’s Daughter
characters.prompt: A smaller, but still imposing troll figure with a stern face and long, unkempt hair. She wears tattered fabrics, possibly adorned with simple beads or bones, in the same ancient Norwegian folkloric style. She stands in the shadows of her father’s cave.

characters.name: The King
characters.prompt: A regal figure seated on a wooden throne ornamented with carved Nordic designs. He wears a crown befitting a 17th-century Norwegian monarch, with a thick fur-trimmed cloak draped over fine but slightly worn robes. He holds a scepter and looks both kind and majestic.

characters.name: The Princess
characters.prompt: A gentle, graceful Norwegian princess dressed in a 17th-century embroidered gown featuring Nordic floral patterns. She has a delicate crown, braided hair, and stands or sits near the King, exuding warmth and curiosity.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: An ornate folk-style illustration set in old Norway (1400-1850). Depict Askeladden returning triumphantly by wooden trough boat across a still fjord under a clouded sky. Show the Troll roaring in frustration on the rocky shore, the King and Princess visible at a distance near a wooden palace. The style should echo traditional Norwegian art, with muted earthy colors and fine details capturing the nature, rustic buildings, and attire of that period.
modernMainImagePrompt: A contemporary scene in present-day Norway, featuring Askeladden as a creative young man in casual outdoor gear. He might be using a modern inflatable raft, with the Troll reimagined as a large figure lurking near a modern lakeside cabin. The King and Princess become a business leader and a modern princess influencer, both standing by a sleek, contemporary Norwegian mansion. Capture a blend of old folklore elements and current-day vibes.
childMainImagePrompt: A bright, friendly illustration for a five-year-old audience. Show a smiling Askeladden in simple clothes, riding a wooden trough boat across a calm lake. The Troll is big but not too scary, peeking out from behind a rock with a silly surprised face. The King and Princess wave happily from a cozy fairytale palace. Use soft lines, warm colors, and playful details that emphasize a fun, magical world.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Et enkelt, moderne norsk eventyrbilde som viser Askeladden i en enkel tresnekke på et rolig norsk vann. Trollene er store og litt morsomme, og kongen, prinsessen og brødrene står på brygga og vinker. Bruk varme farger og et vennlig, tegneserieaktig uttrykk som passer til historien i en enkel og lettfattelig stil.
englishMainImagePrompt: A traditionally styled illustration conveying the essence of an old Norwegian folktale. Show Askeladden in a rustic wooden boat amid a fjord, the imposing Troll watching from a nearby rocky shore, and the King and Princess waiting at a small wooden castle. Include hints of historic rural Norway, with pine forests, mountains, and architecture reflecting the tale’s original spirit.
